services.name: Performance Marketing & Paid Media
services.summary: Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns tuned to cost per lead and return on ad spend.
services.timeline: Campaigns usually go live within a week once tracking, account access and creatives are ready. Expect a learning phase of 2 to 4 weeks, with results reported from day one.
services.pricing: A monthly management fee, separate from your ad spend (billed at actuals), or a fixed-fee campaign sprint for launches.

services.name: Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
services.summary: Technical, local and content SEO that brings buyers who are already searching for you.
services.timeline: Technical and local fixes usually show movement in 4 to 8 weeks. Competitive keywords take 3 to 6 months to climb, and we set expectations per keyword after the audit.
services.pricing: A monthly SEO retainer with a report every month, or a one-time audit and fix project if you want a clean start.

services.name: Social Media Marketing & Community
services.summary: Always-on content and community management that builds a following that buys.
services.timeline: Onboarding and a content calendar take about 1 to 2 weeks, then posting starts. A consistent presence usually shows engagement growth within 2 to 3 months.
services.pricing: A monthly retainer with a fixed number of posts, reels and community hours, or a one-off launch campaign.

services.name: Lead Generation & Funnel Marketing
services.summary: Landing pages, funnels and campaigns designed around one goal: qualified leads at a lower cost.
services.timeline: A landing page takes about 1 to 2 weeks to design and build, and campaigns can go live within a week of that. Event funnels are planned backwards from the event date.
services.pricing: A one-time funnel build followed by a monthly optimisation retainer, or a fixed-fee event campaign.

services.name: Brand Strategy & Online Reputation Management
services.summary: Brand identity, positioning and review management that make people trust you before they call.
services.timeline: A brand identity project usually takes 3 to 6 weeks. Review and reputation work starts within a week, with visible change over 2 to 3 months.
services.pricing: A fixed-scope brand project, or a monthly ORM retainer for reviews and listings.

services.name: Content & Creative Studio
services.summary: Copy, design, video and email that explain what you do and why it matters.
services.timeline: Content production starts within 1 to 2 weeks of the brief, then runs on a monthly calendar.
services.pricing: A monthly content retainer with a fixed volume, or per-project pricing for one-off shoots and campaigns.

services.name: Influencer Marketing
services.summary: Campaigns with creators across fashion, lifestyle, fitness, food, travel and tech.
services.timeline: A campaign usually takes 2 to 4 weeks from brief to going live, including creator shortlisting and approvals.
services.pricing: Priced per campaign (creator fees plus management), or as a monthly always-on creator programme.

services.name: Media Acquisition & Event Branding
services.summary: Localised media buying, print and on-ground branding for launches and events.
services.timeline: Event branding needs about 2 to 4 weeks for design and production. Outdoor and print bookings depend on media availability, so we plan 3 to 6 weeks ahead.
services.pricing: A fixed package per event, or campaign pricing based on the media you book.

services.name: Website & Web Application Development
services.summary: Fast, secure, SEO-ready websites and portals with a CMS your team can run.
services.timeline: A landing page takes about 1 to 2 weeks and a business website 3 to 6 weeks, depending on scope and how quickly content is ready. Portals with custom features take longer.
services.pricing: A written, fixed quote after a free 20-minute consultation, based on pages, features and integrations.

services.name: Custom Software Development
services.summary: Software built around how your business actually works, from MVP to enterprise scale.
services.timeline: Discovery takes 1 to 2 weeks, then a first release usually lands in 6 to 16 weeks depending on scope. Larger systems ship in phases.
services.pricing: A fixed price for a clear scope, or a phased MVP with monthly pricing. Changes are estimated and agreed before they are built.

services.name: Mobile App Development
services.summary: Android and iOS apps, native or cross-platform, built for real-world usage.
services.timeline: A first release of an Android and iOS app usually takes 8 to 16 weeks, including design, build, testing and store approval.
services.pricing: A fixed-scope price for the first release, with an optional maintenance plan after launch.

services.name: CRM, ERP & Business Automation
services.summary: Custom CRMs and workflow automation that remove manual work and show you real-time numbers.
services.timeline: A focused CRM or automation module usually takes 4 to 10 weeks. Wider ERP rollouts go live module by module.
services.pricing: A fixed-scope build for a defined set of modules, or a phased rollout priced per module.

services.name: E-commerce Development
services.summary: Online stores and marketplaces with payments, shipping and inventory that just work.
services.timeline: A store on Yenetch Ecomm can be live in about a week. A custom store usually takes 6 to 12 weeks.
services.pricing: Yenetch Ecomm starts from ₹1,499 a month. Custom stores get a fixed quote after scoping.

services.name: UI/UX & Product Design
services.summary: Research-led interfaces that make products easy to learn and hard to leave.
services.timeline: A design sprint takes 1 to 2 weeks. A full product design or redesign usually takes 4 to 8 weeks.
services.pricing: A fixed-scope design project, or a short design sprint for a single flow.

services.name: AI Solutions & Automation
services.summary: Practical AI: chatbots, kiosks, document processing and generative tools that save hours.
services.timeline: A pilot on one use case usually takes 3 to 6 weeks. A production rollout follows once the pilot proves its value.
services.pricing: A fixed-price pilot first, then a full build priced on the agreed scope.

services.name: Cloud, Hosting & DevOps
services.summary: Managed hosting, cloud migration and CI/CD that keep your systems up and fast.
services.timeline: Hosting setup takes a few days. A migration usually takes 1 to 4 weeks depending on how many systems are involved.
services.pricing: A monthly managed hosting plan, or a fixed-price migration project.

services.name: Website & Application Maintenance
services.summary: Annual maintenance with updates, security patches and a team that answers.
services.timeline: Support starts as soon as the plan is signed. Response times are set in the support terms, with faster handling when a site is down.
services.pricing: An annual maintenance contract with a defined scope, or pay-per-request support.

services.name: Dedicated Development Teams
services.summary: A full product team (developers, QA, designer, PM) working only on your roadmap.
services.timeline: We usually share profiles within a week, and a team can start 1 to 3 weeks after you approve them.
services.pricing: A monthly fee for a full-time team working only on your product. A short pilot sprint is available first.

services.name: IT Staff Augmentation
services.summary: Vetted developers, testers and designers who join your existing team on contract.
services.timeline: Screened profiles usually arrive within 48 hours, and a specialist can start as soon as you finish interviews and pick someone.
services.pricing: Monthly for full-time specialists, or hourly for variable work.

services.name: Marketing Team as a Service
services.summary: A strategist, designer, ad specialist and writer working as your in-house marketing team.
services.timeline: A managed marketing team is usually set up and working within 1 to 2 weeks.
services.pricing: A fixed monthly fee for the agreed team and scope.

services.name: IT Infrastructure on Rent
services.summary: Laptops, desktops and office equipment on a monthly plan through our group company, Reliable IT.
services.timeline: Devices are usually delivered and set up within a few working days, depending on quantity.
services.pricing: Monthly rental with maintenance included, or a fixed rental for a project period.

products.timeline: Your store can be live in about a week: add products, connect payments and shipping, and start selling.

caseStudies.title: A custom CRM that took cab bookings from manual to 24/7
caseStudies.challenge: Manual processes caused booking errors, gave no real-time view of active trips, and customers could not book without calling an agent. Finance and staff performance were impossible to track.
caseStudies.solution: A custom web application with a full CRM, a self-service customer booking panel, automated driver dispatch with live tracking, a finance console for revenue and expense forecasting, and staff and lead dashboards.

quote.text: Outstanding work on our app. Operations are far smoother than before.
quote.name: Ravi Verma

caseStudies.title: Filling a niche professional event in an unfamiliar city
caseStudies.challenge: SLP Quest, a division of Insight Rehabilitation, wanted to host an event for speech-language pathologists in Jaipur, where the audience was small, spread out and unaware of the organisation.
caseStudies.solution: One high-trust funnel landing page to capture registrations fast, backed by precisely targeted social campaigns aimed at SLP professionals to keep cost per acquisition low.

caseStudies.title: Building trust and a lead engine for a new study-abroad brand
caseStudies.challenge: A newly launched consultancy for admissions to French colleges had zero awareness, low lead volume and few admissions, in a sector often associated with scams.
caseStudies.solution: A trust-first campaign with student testimonials and useful content, social lead magnets, and a custom CRM with a self-serve course finder that manages students, partner universities, leads and courses.

caseStudies.title: Turning social ads into record exhibition sales
caseStudies.challenge: A Jaipur ethnic-wear label needed to fill its twice-yearly exhibitions with qualified buyers, but website traffic was low and its lead funnel was unoptimised.
caseStudies.solution: A dedicated funnel landing page with precise targeting, plus PPC and data-driven social branding campaigns aimed at high-value buyers in the region.

caseStudies.title: Selling electric scooters as an income opportunity
caseStudies.challenge: During the pandemic, generic messaging had worn audiences out and buyers were wary of large purchases.
caseStudies.solution: A three-pillar social strategy: contextual storytelling around moments like Ozone Day, bold product showcases, and reframing the scooter as an income-generating asset through franchise stories.

caseStudies.title: A scalable website and CMS for a medical college
caseStudies.challenge: JMCH needed a fast, secure website that staff could keep current across courses, departments, faculty and notices.
caseStudies.solution: A fully custom responsive website on a role-based CMS for pages, courses, departments, faculty profiles, notices, galleries and downloads, built for performance, security and SEO.

caseStudies.title: Launching a luxury gym in a crowded local market
caseStudies.challenge: A new luxury health club in Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur needed visibility fast to hit aggressive first-month membership targets.
caseStudies.solution: A high-reach social awareness campaign that positioned NUYU as the premier club in the area from launch week.

caseStudies.title: End-to-end branding for Arena '26 university sports event
caseStudies.challenge: RUHS needed event management, print production and flawless on-ground execution for its annual sports event.
caseStudies.solution: Custom-designed branding elements, large-format print production and coordinated setup across every venue.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: It depends on pages, features and integrations. Business websites usually start with a fixed quote after a free 20-minute consultation, and online stores can start on Yenetch Ecomm from ₹1,499/month.

faqs.q: How long does a project take?
faqs.a: A landing page takes about 1 to 2 weeks, a business website 3 to 6 weeks, and custom software or apps 6 to 16 weeks depending on scope. Marketing campaigns can go live within a week.
Our head office is at Landmark Cyber Park, Sector 67, Gurugram, and our delivery centre is in Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur. We work with clients across India and abroad.

faqs.q: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with clients in France and other countries, with overlapping hours for calls and English-first communication.
ASP.NET and .NET Core, Node.js, PHP, Python, React, Angular, Flutter, React Native, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS and Azure, chosen to fit your project.

faqs.q: Who owns the code and data?
faqs.a: You do. Source code, designs and data are transferred to you, and we sign an NDA before any discussion if you need one.

faqs.q: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. Every project includes a free support window, and annual maintenance plans cover updates, security patches and priority fixes.
We are growing and regularly hire developers, designers and marketers in Gurugram and Jaipur. See the Careers page or send your CV to hello@yenetch.com.
